navigation.notes: The /print/ hub lists all 134 issue pages on one page (1949, 2000-2026) with no pagination. Each issue page links per-article detail pages; the PDF href lives on the article page. Pre-2017 issues use /print/volume-YYYY-issue-N/ and host PDFs same-origin under /wp-content/uploads/. 2017+ issues use /print/vol-YYYY-no-N/ and host PDFs on the companion install illinoislawrev.web.illinois.edu/wp-content/uploads/ -- IllinoisLawReviewAdapter allowlists that one host (uploads path only) so the origin gate still rejects reference-list PDFs. Volume 2000-2002 article pages are HTML abstract stubs with no PDF. WP REST reports 947 PDF attachments on the vanity host; the companion host holds the 2017+ files. The /online/ companion (University of Illinois Law Review Online) is a separate sub-publication with its own seed, registry_university_of_illinois_law_review_online_2006_0915da72be.json; it is deliberately NOT included here (sub-publication suffix guard). Year coverage confirmed 2026-08-28: one 1949 issue plus continuous 2000-2026 (134 issue pages). There is NO pre-2000 backfile here. The legacy mirror publish.illinois.edu/lawreview/archives/ indexes volumes 1995-2015 but every 'Download PDF' points at https://www.law.illinois.edu/content/ilr/articles/ which returns HTTP 410 Gone, so it yields nothing; it is left in the adapter's companion-host allowlist only in case it is restored.
